title: The full editor, part 2: parts of the site to place on a page, and a page's search settings
why: decisions/0159 step 4b. Live components (0159 §3.3): a registry in code (Blocks::LIVE: name, what it is, settings, where it may go), placed and set up in the editor, drawn by the site's own code and data: a search box (the site's search, or the directory without it), businesses (cards from /api/search_listings.php, so the directory's public rules apply, drawn to the card standard: the name the link, Link top right, Call, Directions and Website as round icon buttons counted with data-out, under the name on phones; a plain link to all of them), a map button (the site's own map, js/map-view.js, loaded when first used), a guide (a town's guide card, only when it has published sections) and a GO Code (the page's QR code and trvgo.us address from ShortCodes::forPage). Each works as a plain link without its script (js/tv-blocks.js, loaded only on a page that has one). In the editor: Add → Parts of the site, each with its settings; the preview starts them. On a page of ours, the Page tab sets its title, search description and share picture (SitePages::save, Pages: publish, saved at once). The engage bar and a form as parts of the site, the header and footer, and scheduled publishing are 4c. FAQ updated.
